blockers.quote: You buy mom the fridge she wanted.
blockers.why: The viewer's week. A fridge is not Riya's week (chai, the bus or metro, exams, the office, family). Her mother calls twice a day; that is the household this gag had to use.
blockers.fix: You pay your mother's phone bill, the twice-a-day calls, and you don't tell her.

blockers.quote: You expected to look distinguished; you got your uncle's eyebrow.
blockers.why: The viewer's week. An uncle is not in the family she actually has. The elder face at every visit is her grandfather.
blockers.fix: You expected to look distinguished; you got your grandfather's eyebrow.

blockers.quote: You expect Mom's new kitchen to let her rest; she cooks more, for a child who now looks forty.
blockers.why: The viewer's week. A new kitchen is not chai, the bus, exams, the office, or this family, and it repeats the exam gap I just watched.
blockers.fix: Cut this sentence. Go from the exam line to: You expect his medicine to be the last tap; the pharmacy bill asks for another.
